title: Request flow (gateway → runtime → sandbox)
content:
This process describes the plumbing-only request flow:

1. Client sends `POST /v1/messages` to the HTTP gateway.
2. Gateway forwards the request to the runtime via gRPC `SubmitUserMessage`.
3. Client optionally opens `GET /v1/stream?request_id=...` for SSE; gateway proxies the runtime's gRPC stream.
4. Runtime can call KB search (Qdrant) and tool execution (tool sandbox) without implementing any agent reasoning.

This document exists to seed and validate KB ingestion + search.
